body:
## Purpose

Complete the disposable retained-view integration against the creator's **already accepted** contracts. This is ordinary implementation work, outside the Wayfinder decision map. It does not select an architecture, certify feasibility or authorize a production merge.

The creator has [retained this candidate provisionally and accepted the accumulated experiment as incomplete with scoped repair evidence](https://github.com/ejjsharpe/escode/issues/33#issuecomment-6478428043). That prerequisite decision is complete. This issue remains an implementation backlog, not authorization to launch every workstream automatically. The [creator-approved decision-only map boundary](https://github.com/ejjsharpe/escode/issues/22#issuecomment-6478721978) keeps this work separate from design approval; closing the map does not complete this issue or certify feasibility.

## Source and contract

- Current published disposable source/evidence: [whole-window Close experiment](https://github.com/ejjsharpe/escode/blob/d6f73d25b56/prototypes/live-hosting/product-close/README.md), runtime `a330d2a1016`, evidence `d6f73d25b56`, branch `prototype/whole-window-close`.
- [Consolidated evidence review](https://github.com/ejjsharpe/escode/issues/33#issuecomment-6478224295) distinguishes historical failures, scoped repairs and unperformed checks.
- [Final audited design approval and profile-target clarification](https://github.com/ejjsharpe/escode/issues/22#issuecomment-6478807512): an exact already-open workspace requested with another explicit profile reuses its tab and applies the profile through project-scoped safeguards; cancellation preserves the original tab/profile. This is an accepted requirement, not an implementation result.
- Accepted contracts: [Choose how independent project workbenches share one window](https://github.com/ejjsharpe/escode/issues/20), [Define project ownership and navigation for chats](https://github.com/ejjsharpe/escode/issues/17), [Define project tab lifecycle and background activity](https://github.com/ejjsharpe/escode/issues/18), [Define fresh-app startup, opening and recovery behavior](https://github.com/ejjsharpe/escode/issues/24).
- The [frozen complete inherited acceptance contract](https://github.com/ejjsharpe/escode/issues/33#issuecomment-6478223824) is retained without waiver. The separate validation issue owns acceptance.

## Implementation inventory

Inspect the current source before deciding that an untested behavior needs new code. Reuse existing bounded services and interfaces; add only the missing integration. Scope one execution batch to a named scenario/failure and source baseline before starting it.

- [ ] Complete remaining hosted native/direct-service adapters and registered auxiliary ownership. Include shared/PTY/agent-host ports and downstream scopes, restart/policy and relevant native/main/utility boundaries. Preserve explicit caller/document/connection identity, role and target scope before dispatch/effects, event/reply/port ownership and revocation. The full matrix belongs in validation; classifying one method is not completion.
- [ ] Complete ordinary project-tab Close and its shell/control integration, if incomplete. Preserve active/inactive/final-project selection, real safeguard outcomes, lifecycle/registry/listener/restoration cleanup, independent provider work and host/neighbour usability. Whole-window Close is separate and coordinates all workbenches.
- [ ] Complete opening/reuse/CLI and restoration integration that still assumes one native window per workbench. Preserve exact workspace/environment/profile, file/line and diff/merge targets, `--wait` ownership, fresh state, unavailable-target retry/close and no replay.
- [ ] Complete provider-neutral Project Chats/Agents attachment and presentation handoff against the existing provider owner. Preserve exact provider/session/chat identity, draft/attachment/model/reading/streaming/approval state, and a real execution/tool/approval lifetime independent of project closure. No second transcript store, duplicate send/claim or retention of the entire supposedly closed workbench. No new provider is in scope.
- [ ] Complete any native selected-workbench command/focus/dialog or hidden-view interaction integration exposed by the agreed usability tests. Measure resource cost before proposing optimization or numerical budgets; do not suspend/close workspaces to manufacture a pass.
- [ ] Retain all prior lifecycle, readiness, recovery, disposal, shared-outcome, interrupted-operation and explicit-retry contracts while making these changes. A known failure against an accepted contract is a repair; a contract conflict requires a creator decision.

## Boundaries and completion

Use disposable branches, independent dependencies/outputs, fresh app-owned profiles and scratch workspaces. No production merge, general recovery framework, automatic replay/retry, permanent retry UI, new authorization framework or weakened safeguards is authorized. Preserve existing layering and provider-neutral contracts.

Existing creator directions remain: sign-in/provider work was deferred, and authorization probes are paused. Reorganization does not lift either constraint. Do useful authorized preparation while recording blocked coverage; do not fabricate results or request credentials through issue content.

Each batch ends with changed surfaces, exact source/build, meaningful focused checks, failures/repairs and a handoff to validation. Do not automatically expand it into another subsystem. Track necessary child implementation batches here only when their scope is precise. This implementation issue cannot certify the full validation gate or close merely because an inventory exists. Any remaining required integration stays open and continues to block validation acceptance.

If evidence reveals the accepted contract cannot be met, return one precise question, alternatives and supporting evidence to the decision map. Do not reopen all accepted design topics for an incomplete adapter.

## Validation handoff

[Validate retained-view hosting against the full accepted contract](https://github.com/ejjsharpe/escode/issues/35) owns reproducible scenario coverage and the full acceptance verdict. It remains natively blocked by this implementation issue until necessary integration is complete, and separately owns runtime acceptance. The creator separated design-map approval from implementation and validation; design approval does not satisfy or waive that gate.
